definitions.explanation: A story that is invented or made up rather than based on fact. Often carries a negative nuance suggesting deception or lying.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{作|つく}り{話|ばなし}だろう。
examples.english: That's a made-up story, isn't it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{作|つく}り{話|ばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧わかった。
examples.english: I could tell right away that the child was making up a story.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧{作|つく}り{話|ばなし}だったこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{判明|はんめい}→判明：11785_hanmei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was later revealed that all those rumors were fabricated stories.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make) + ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ (story), with rendaku changing はなし to ばなし. Usually implies the story is meant to deceive, unlike ⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧ (tale, narrative) or ⟦フィクション→フィクション：11005_fikushon⟧ (fiction), which are neutral terms for creative works.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {作|つく}り{話|ばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (make up a story, tell a lie)
- ⟦{全|まった}く→全く：02363_mattaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作|つく}り{話|ばなし} (a complete fabrication)
- {作|つく}り{話|ばなし}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見抜|みぬ}く→見抜く：06975_minuku⟧ (see through a made-up story)
